run_ur5_ee_pose_control: run the UR5 robot arm end-effector pose control example with target poses
create_ur5_robot_instance: create a UR5 robot instance with arm enabled and base, camera, gripper disabled
move_arm_to_neutral: move the UR5 robot arm to its neutral position before executing poses
set_ee_pose_with_plan: set the UR5 robot arm end-effector pose using position and orientation with planning
compute_forward_kinematics: compute the forward kinematics position of the UR5 arm end-effector link from joint angles
